taxon.wikipedia_summary: Orobanche minor, (hellroot, common broomrape, lesser broomrape, small broomrape or clover broomrape), is a holoparasitic angiosperm belonging to the genus Orobanche; a genus of about 150 non-photosynthetic plants that parasitize other autotrophic plants.
